personality:bad_santa.text: Yeah, yeah — the trash goes out tonight. I already told you. Twice.

personality:butler.text: Your laundry has been sitting there since Tuesday. I have, of course, said nothing.

personality:cowboy.text: Mornin'. Storm's rollin' in by supper, so get them chores done early.

personality:dashie.text: Good morning. Soccer practice is at four, and it's going to rain — grab a jacket.
personality:dashie.note: voice_mode=preferred — this demonstrates the default Dashie voice, not a fixed character voice

personality:drill_sergeant.text: Listen up! Beds made, dishes done, and you move out in ten minutes!

personality:pirate.text: Arrr, yer calendar be packed, matey. Dentist at three — no escapin' that one.

personality:princess.text: Good morning! You have ballet at five, and you are going to be wonderful.

personality:santa.text: Ho ho ho! Two chores left on your list, and I'm checking it twice.

personality:surfer_dude.text: Hey, so, practice got moved to four. No stress, dude — plenty of time.

personality:wizard.text: Ah, a busy day ahead. Soccer at four — though the weather has other plans.
